id: title:arnohillen:add tag vocabulary explainer and clear all

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a dedicated utility and action to manage scanner configuration parameters and classifier tags, replacing ad-hoc construction to prevent stale template keys from causing configuration lock or category misattribution.
review.reason: Adds a dedicated utility and action to manage scanner configuration parameters and classifier tags, replacing ad-hoc construction to prevent stale template keys from causing configuration lock or category misattribution.
review.uncertainty: The exact downstream impact of clearing stale template keys and the specific benefit of the new utility cannot be independently verified without execution or broader context; the score relies on the stated intent and replacement of ad-hoc logic rather than observed runtime behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new utility function and its tests, P1.F4.H1 and P1.F3.H1, to compute the search parameters passed when a template card starts the scanner flow. P1.F4.H1 adds the function; P1.F3.H1 adds tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the previous ad-hoc parameter construction in P1.F2.H2 with a dedicated utility, P1.F4.H1, and its tests, P1.F3.H1, to carry the template key while stripping stale ones. This could help prevent downstream readers from treating a stale template key as the source of the config, which could lock the type selector and misattribute categories.

observations.behavior: Adds a new action and its implementation, P1.F6.H1 and P1.F6.H3, to clear classifier tags. P1.F6.H1 adds the action; P1.F6.H3 adds the implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new action, P1.F6.H1, and its implementation, P1.F6.H3, to clear classifier tags. This could help users clear classifier tags, which could help prevent downstream readers from treating a stale template key as the source of the config, which could lock the type selector and misattribute categories.
